title: Fixed-target internal Hom is adjoint to its opposite
statement: Let C be any category, H:C^op × C → C and S a closed tensor-Hom structure for H [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Assume the monoidal structure of S is symmetric. For any M in C put D_M(K)=H(K,M), a functor C^op → C. Then D_M.rightOp:C → C^op is left adjoint to D_M. No reflexivity or dualizability hypothesis is required.

source.place: The first and last tensor-Hom arrows of the displayed Hom chain, and symmetry of tensor.

proof.text: Use the adjunction for right tensoring to prove naturality of transposition in its tensor parameter. Apply inverse transposition, use evaluation naturality and the tensor exchange identity; injectivity gives the claimed naturality.

For K in C and L in C^op identify Hom_C^op(D_M(K),L) with Hom_C(L,D_M(K)), uncurry to Hom_C(L tensor K,M), precompose by symmetry K tensor L → L tensor K, and curry to Hom_C(K,D_M(L)). This is a composite of equivalences.

Naturality in K follows from inverse transposition naturality and the left braiding square; naturality in L follows from ordinary adjunction naturality, the right braiding square and transposition naturality in its parameter. Apply Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv.
